settings.content: Configure global SEO settings for your store. These settings apply site-wide unless overridden on individual pages.

settings.label: Meta Keywords
settings.info: Comma-separated keywords for SEO (e.g., vastu kit, vastu shastra, home vastu solutions). Note: Meta keywords have limited SEO value but some search engines still use them.
settings.default: vastu kit, vastu shastra, vastu remedies, home vastu solutions, vastu correction kit, vastu wall paintings

settings.label: Robots Index Setting
settings.info: Control how search engines index your site. 'index, follow' is recommended for most sites.

settings.label: Homepage Open Graph Image
settings.info: Image used when homepage is shared on social media. Recommended size: 1200x630px. If not set, will use shop logo or first slideshow image.

settings.label: Homepage Title Override
settings.info: Custom title for homepage. Leave blank to use default SEO-optimized title.

settings.label: Homepage Meta Description Override
settings.info: Custom meta description for homepage. Leave blank to use default SEO-optimized description.

settings.label: Enable FAQ Schema
settings.info: Add FAQ structured data to FAQ sections for rich results in search.

settings.label: Enable Breadcrumb Schema
settings.info: Add breadcrumb structured data for better navigation in search results.

settings.label: Enable Review/Rating Schema
settings.info: Add review structured data to testimonial sections for star ratings in search.
